heading_en: Credit Risk-Weighted Assets for Trade Exposures to Central Counterparties and Trade Exposures to Direct Clearing Participants
summary_ja: 中央清算機関及び直接清算参加者向けトレード・エクスポージャーには第三章を準用し、適格中央清算機関と直接清算参加者向けは原則二パーセントのリスク・ウェイトとする。
summary_en: Chapter 3 applies mutatis mutandis to trade exposures to central counterparties and to direct clearing participants, with a 2% risk weight for qualifying central counterparties and direct clearing participants (4% in a defined case), and special margin-period and holding-period rules.
paragraphs: The provisions of Chapter 3 (excluding Article 47, paragraph (4), items (ii) and (iii)) shall apply mutatis mutandis to the calculation of the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for trade exposures to central counterparties and trade exposures to direct clearing participants. In this case, the phrase "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" shall be deemed to be replaced with "Ultimate Designated Parent Company".

Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, when calculating the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the trade exposures listed in the following items, the risk weight of those trade exposures shall be 2%. (i) Trade exposures to a qualifying central counterparty. (ii) Trade exposures to direct clearing participants.

Where the provisions of Chapter 3 apply mutatis mutandis under paragraph (1) (limited to cases using SA-CCR), if a qualifying central counterparty becomes insolvent and no measures have been taken to prevent losses on the collateral that is scheduled to be received from that qualifying central counterparty as variation margin, the margin period of risk shall be the shorter of the longest number of business days among M_{i} of the transactions included in the netting set (or 10 business days where that is fewer than 10 business days) and the number of business days in one year.

Where the provisions of Chapter 3 apply mutatis mutandis under paragraph (1) and the expected exposure method is used, in Article 49, paragraph (11), item (i), the phrase "(a) through (d)" shall be deemed to be replaced with "(a), (b) or (d)", in item (i)(a) of that paragraph, the phrase "(b) or (c)" shall be deemed to be replaced with "(b)", and in item (i)(d) of that paragraph, the phrase "(a) through (c)" shall be deemed to be replaced with "(a) or (b)". However, if that qualifying central counterparty becomes insolvent and no measures have been taken to prevent losses on the collateral that is scheduled to be received from that qualifying central counterparty as variation margin, the margin period of risk shall be the shorter of the longest number of business days among the residual maturities of the transactions included in the netting set (or 10 business days where that is fewer than 10 business days) and the number of business days in one year.

Where the provisions of Chapter 3 apply mutatis mutandis under paragraph (1), the phrase "netting sets that include illiquid collateral or hard-to-replace derivative transactions, and netting sets for which the number of transactions exceeded 5,000 at any point during the Ultimate Designated Parent Company quarter immediately preceding the Ultimate Designated Parent Company quarter that includes the calculation reference date" in Article 76, paragraph (2), item (i)(e) shall be deemed to be replaced with "netting sets that include illiquid collateral or hard-to-replace derivative transactions". In this case, if, when that qualifying central counterparty becomes insolvent, no measures have been taken to prevent losses on the collateral that is scheduled to be received from that qualifying central counterparty as variation margin, the minimum holding period shall be the shorter of the longest number of business days among the residual maturities of the transactions included in the netting set (or 10 business days where that is fewer than 10 business days) and the number of business days in one year.

Notwithstanding paragraph (1), when calculating the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for trade exposures to direct clearing participants (limited to cases where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company is an indirect clearing participant and, when both the direct clearing participant and the other indirect clearing participants have defaulted or become insolvent, neither the qualifying central counterparty nor the direct clearing participant has taken measures to prevent losses to the Ultimate Designated Parent Company), the risk weight of those trade exposures to direct clearing participants shall be 4%.
